info.title: Even the Student Council Has Its Holes!
info.synopsis: Ume Mizunoe è uno studente di una prestigiosa scuola situata alla periferia della città, che si ritrova costretto a diventare un rappresentante del consiglio studentesco per evitare di ripetere l'anno. Ma i membri di questo consiglio sono un po' particolari: alcuni sono sciocchi, altri sono scontrosi o addirittura spaventosi... ma stranamente tutti quanti risultano carini nel loro comportamento! Ecco che inizia una strana e amichevole vita liceale con dei membri del consiglio studentesco veramente unici.

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: Ume Mizunoe joins the student council so he doesn't have to repeat a year, but everyone there has such unique personalities. He nervously starts working there and gets thrown around by the council's strong personalities!

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: Ume drops by the student council room as he takes care of something early in the morning. He then finds a young girl covered in blood slumped over a desk! And it seems the girl has become quite attached to Ume!?

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: When Ume gets home, he finds a suspicious figure—who turns out to be none other than his sister, Sho Mizunoe! Sho, Arisu, and Komaro engage in a who-knows-Ume-more one-upping battle. What's going on here!?

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: The student council receives a complaint from the British tea ceremony club that the nearby music club is too noisy. It's not the instruments causing the noise, but something a bit more sensual!?

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: Ume and Tan sneak around to study Arisu, whose true nature remains a bit of a mystery. When they see an opening and rummage through Arisu's things, she suddenly comes back out of nowhere! What are they going to do now!?
